items.a: Cline scored **77.5%** on Terminal-Bench 2.1 while the model paper claimed **~85%**.
Ran evals, **bucketed failures by category**, patched the harness and re-ran—**17 hours** autonomously.

items.q: What kinds of harness bugs did it find?
items.a: **Loop detection**, runaway **background processes** and file-index issues.

items.q: What must graders check besides pass/fail?
items.a: Turns, tokens, latency, trajectory and **reward hacking**.

items.q: What can be optimised this way?
items.a: Anything with a **verifiable loop**—even firmware and hardware.

items.q: How does Ara view every human correction to an agent?
items.a: As a **capability delta** that post-training can close.
**Move closer to the RSI loop**: evals, data, post-training, inference, hardware.

items.q: Which products are most at risk?
items.a: Thin 'agents for X' apps **one model release away** from being wiped out.

items.q: What kind of problem should you pick?
items.a: One that **benefits from scale** but **isn't solved by scale alone**.
